title: FEA max bending stress uses c = sqrt(A)/2 (square-section assumption) inconsistent with section I, so stress and utilization are under-reported (unconservative)
repro_steps: Cantilever: node fa 0,0,0 Fixed; fb 78.74 in Free; default member A=8.25 in^2, I=82.8 in^4, A36 E=200 GPa; Fy=-2248.09 lb at fb; Run FEA
expected: sigma = M*c/I with the section's real extreme-fiber distance (e.g. W8-class depth ~8 in gives c ~4 in, sigma ~8,600 psi, ~40% utilization)
actual: Deflection 0.1524 in matches PL^3/3EI (0.1523 in). But max stress shows 3070.3 psi / 14.2% PASS. M = PL = 177,016 lb-in, so implied c = 3070.3*82.8/177016 = 1.436 in = sqrt(8.25)/2 exactly. That's a solid square's half-depth, while I=82.8 in^4 can't belong to a square of 8.25 in^2 (that square has I=5.67 in^4). Stress is likely under-reported about 2.8x for the real shape; the 'check passed' receipt can pass members that fail.
suspected_area: engineering FEA stress recovery (section c / section modulus)
fix_note: FEA bending stress used an area-only square-section assumption for the extreme-fiber distance. computeStresses now derives c from the section's own geometry (c = sqrt(3I/A) for the rectangular identity the inputs imply) and rows carry cIn + cBasis; the audit case moves from 3,070 psi / 14.2% to 11,731 psi / 54.3%, consistent with the reported moment of inertia — the SAP2000/ETABS behaviour of recovering stress from the section's real section modulus. Pin: server/tests/fea-stress-section-consistency.test.js.

title: Opening Council signed in silently adds the viewer to the shared voter pool (auto member-join, no consent)
repro_steps: Sign in
Open /lenses/council
Member count / eligible voters includes viewer
expected: Joining the council is an explicit opt-in action
actual: CouncilChamber auto-calls member-join on signed-in mount (CouncilChamber.tsx:390-399 per zuko 3 static code check); QA account assumed now a member of the shared pool
source: zuko 3 code scope check, filed by Lens Tester 4
close_rule: Closes only after live re-run of original repro + nearby smoke on affected lens
fix_note: Founder ruling A (2026-11-13): membership is explicit opt-in. Premise confirmed at branch state: CouncilChamber's mount effect called member-join for every signed-in viewer (quorum is a majority of members, so drive-by joins distorted it). The mount auto-join is retired entire; a membership bar under the header carries the explicit controls — Join the council (member-join) and Leave the council (new member-leave action, removes only the caller's own record, idempotent). Already-joined accounts stay members until they leave; no record was removed by this fix. The non-member vote hint now points at the Join control. Pins: server council-member-explicit-join.test.js 4/4 (reads never join; join once; leave removes only the caller; anon gated) + FE source pin CouncilExplicitMembership.test.tsx. NAMED: (1) proposal-create still ensures the AUTHOR's membership implicitly (cEnsureMember) — an explicit authoring act, outside the ruling's named scope (opening the lens); the desk/founder may rule it separately. (2) Pre-existing at pristine head, not this ticket: council-domain-parity 'A proposes, B sees and votes' fails (proposal.eligible reads 0 after proposal-create, expected 1) — verified against origin council.js bytes.

title: ▶ Playtest mints a live public world that has no owner Settings/Delete in Sub-worlds My Worlds and is not removed by draft delete; world becomes uncleanable
fix_note: Founder ruling A (2026-11-13): playtest stays private. Premise at branch state: the worlds table has NO privacy column; the mint (POST /api/worlds from playtest-check's payload) wrote an unmarked active row, the B15 bridge rendered every table row privacy:'public' + enterable in Sub-Worlds Discover, the public GET /api/worlds listed every active row, bridged rows carried can_edit/is_owner false so no Settings/Delete reached them, and draft-delete never touched the row. Fix: playtest-check's payload carries playtest.draftId; POST /api/worlds stamps rule_modulators.playtest on the row (founded worlds unmarked, unchanged). Public legs cut at the read: GET /api/worlds filters marked rows; Sub-Worlds Discover skips marked rows (a public draft's copy still surfaces as the draft view — sharing stays publishing's job); Sub-Worlds visit refuses marked rows to non-owners ('world is private', the A3 shape); tableView labels a marked row 'private' in the owner's own lists. Disposal: world-creator draft-delete cascades to every marked row naming the draft (linked mint + unlinked orphans), owner-guarded, marked-rows only; sub_worlds archive (the Settings/Delete verb) now also resolves marked table rows for their owner. FE: DraftEditor no longer swallows the draft-publish link failure — it reports in words that the copy stays private and dies with the draft. Pins: server world-creator-playtest-privacy.test.js 6/6 on the fixed tree, 6/6 failing at pristine; seam-bridge + both parity suites + 69 neighbouring world tests green. NAMED: (1) direct entry by world id through the Concordia world runtime (loadWorld by id) is unchanged — every in-product surface that can REVEAL the id to a non-owner is cut, but link-proof entry gating is a platform slice for the desk if the founder wants it. (2) The My Worlds FE settings panel still opens only on store worlds (the B15 bridge's standing can_edit seam) — the archive verb reaches playtest rows server-side now; panel wiring for bridged rows is the bridge seam's own follow-up. (3) Re-playtesting a draft mints a fresh copy each time; earlier copies stay owner-only and die with the draft.
